not_found: The AfPP About page names board members but gives no individual titles, and omits the President, President Elect and Immediate Past President by name, so those roles are not recorded.
AfPP Annual National Conference 2026 (7-8 August 2026, Wyboston Lakes): the conference site lists no named speakers, and its speakers page is the 2025 placeholder with no names.
AfPP chief executive and other paid staff skipped as per brief (Alex Duke, Dan Donnelly shown on the page without a trustee title).
RCS England has no full Council list that could be fetched (the college's council page returned 404), so only the people named in the 2026 election news item are recorded.
LinkedIn searches were not run: the web search allowance for the session was used up, so every linkedin_url is null.
